facts.text: XTDrone is a UAV simulation platform based on PX4, ROS and Gazebo, and its README says algorithms can be deployed to real UAVs after simulation testing.
The multi-vehicle launch places typhoon_h480_0 in the typhoon_h480_0 namespace and includes MAVROS inside that group.
The generated topic list records /typhoon_h480_0/mavros/local_position/pose.
The generated topic list records /typhoon_h480_0/mavros/setpoint_position/local.
The generated topic list records /typhoon_h480_0/mavros/setpoint_raw/target_local.
The ground-control script publishes PoseStamped targets on the vehicle's relative setpoint_position/local topic.
The iris_0 MAVROS config sets setpoint_position tf frame_id to map and mav_frame to LOCAL_NED.
The communication node publishes a MAVROS PositionTarget on the relative setpoint_raw/local topic.
The communication node's start method republishes the last target in a loop until ROS shutdown.
The module creates a 30 Hz ROS rate object.
The cmd handler ignores the exact string 'stop controlling' and the empty string, as well as a repeat of the last command.
The hover transition treats speeds within 0.02 and a yaw rate within 0.005 as a hover request and constructs a target from the cached current position and yaw.
The hover method constructs its target from the cached current position and yaw.
The target constructor signature names the acceleration components afx, afy and afz.
The acceleration callbacks call the target constructor with ax, ay and az keywords, which the signature does not accept.
The node's arm and disarm helpers test the whole CommandBool service response object rather than its success field.
The flight mode helper tests the whole SetMode service response object rather than its mode_sent field.
The multirotor communication node builds a CommandBool service proxy from vehicle_type, vehicle_id and the suffix /mavros/cmd/arming.
The multirotor communication node builds a SetMode service proxy from vehicle_type, vehicle_id and the suffix /mavros/set_mode.

The plane communication node builds a CommandBool service proxy from vehicle_type, vehicle_id and the suffix /mavros/cmd/arming, and a SetMode service proxy from vehicle_type, vehicle_id and the suffix /mavros/set_mode.
The vendored gazebo_ros package.xml declares version 2.8.7.
The vendored gazebo_ros package.xml declares a catkin buildtool dependency.
The vendored gazebo_ros changelog header is 2.8.7 (2020-05-01).
The vendored gazebo_ros_pkgs README links its sensors document on the melodic-devel branch.
The vendored RELEASE.md lists ROS Melodic with Gazebo 9.
The API plugin member enable_ros_network_ is initialized true.
The API plugin creates its node handle with ros::NodeHandle("~").
gazeboQueueThread calls gazebo_queue_.callAvailable with a 0.001 s wall duration while nh_->ok().
advertiseServices returns without advertising when enable_ros_network_ is false.
The API plugin connects wrenchBodySchedulerSlot, forceJointSchedulerSlot and publishSimTime to WorldUpdateBegin.
The API plugin advertises the service get_physics_properties with type gazebo_msgs::GetPhysicsProperties.
The API plugin advertises the service pause_physics with type std_srvs::Empty.
The API plugin advertises the service unpause_physics with type std_srvs::Empty.
getPhysicsProperties sets res.pause to world_->IsPaused().
When the physics engine type is not ode, getPhysicsProperties sets success false and returns false.
pausePhysics calls world_->SetPaused(true) and returns true.
unpausePhysics calls world_->SetPaused(false) and returns true.
The gazebo network API test lists /gazebo/get_physics_properties with type gazebo_msgs/GetPhysicsProperties.
The gazebo network API test lists /gazebo/pause_physics with type std_srvs/Empty.
The GetPhysicsProperties response field pause is commented true if the physics engine is paused.
empty_world.launch defaults its gui argument to true.
empty_world.launch defaults its physics argument to ode.
empty_world.launch defaults use_sim_time to true.
empty_world.launch defaults enable_ros_network to true.
empty_world.launch sets the parameter /use_sim_time to $(arg use_sim_time).
empty_world.launch sets script_type to gzserver unless debug is true, in which case script_type is debug.
empty_world.launch starts a node named gazebo from package gazebo_ros.
When gui is true, empty_world.launch starts the node gazebo_gui of type gzclient.
multi_vehicle.launch defaults its world to $(find mavlink_sitl_gazebo)/worlds/empty.world.
multi_vehicle.launch defaults gui to true, debug to true and paused to false.
multi_vehicle.launch includes gazebo_ros empty_world.launch and passes gui, world_name, debug, verbose and paused.
multi_vehicle.launch includes $(find px4)/launch/single_vehicle_spawn_xtd.launch with vehicle typhoon_h480 inside the typhoon_h480_0 group.
multi_vehicle.launch opens a group whose namespace is typhoon_h480_1.
The typhoon_h480 mavlink_interface plugin sets enable_lockstep to true.

determinism.notes: Canned target and pose samples plus a recorded setpoint publish and a paused flag; no physics step, PX4 process or wall-clock pacing

gaps: the fake is an analytic ROS-free transport: it answers the declared topics and the two Gazebo services and runs no XTDrone node, PX4 SITL, Gazebo, MAVROS or physics
the pose sample is a placeholder and does not move, so the fake does not model arrival; the zero header stamp is a wire placeholder

the fake does not model the communication node's 30 Hz loop, hover transition or PositionTarget publication; the acceleration callbacks pass ax/ay/az into a constructor that accepts afx/afy/afz and stay unsupported
the position inputs are operator_required; site-limits.example.json is example test data only

the stop is the vendored gazebo_ros pause flag: /gazebo/pause_physics sets it and /gazebo/get_physics_properties reports it; the fake runs no Gazebo World::Step, and the effect of SetPaused on the step loop is Gazebo's and is not in this clone

no unpause is offered (SAFE-042): multirotor_communication.py:55-61 republishes target_motion until shutdown and :149-151 ignores 'stop controlling', and this package cannot clear that retained target; PX4 offboard setpoint retention is not traced in this clone because the PX4 launch is $(find px4)

the Gazebo GUI (empty_world.launch starts gzclient when gui is true, and multi_vehicle.launch defaults gui to true) or any client of unpause_physics can unpause the world, and MHS does not watch the flag after the e-stop; safety_status returns the cached confirmation from the last successful read-back and does not call get_physics_properties again, so it cannot detect that unpause

a non-ODE engine makes get_physics_properties return false, so the e-stop stays unconfirmed with the latch held; ODE is empty_world.launch's default physics argument, which multi_vehicle.launch does not override; the default world file $(find mavlink_sitl_gazebo)/worlds/empty.world is not in this clone

the vendored gazebo_ros is 2.8.7 (changelog header 2020-05-01), catkin, with README links on melodic-devel and RELEASE.md listing ROS Melodic with Gazebo 9; this package claims no Noetic build, and rosbridge cannot read the running version
pause_physics pauses the whole world, including typhoon_h480_1 (multi_vehicle.launch:51), which this package does not command; only typhoon_h480_0 is on the accepted surface
the communication node publishes PositionTarget on setpoint_raw/local and formation_gcs publishes PoseStamped on setpoint_position/local, so either can overwrite a publication from this package
arming and OFFBOARD stay outside MHS; the CommandBool and SetMode proxies at multirotor_communication.py:50-51 and plane_communication.py:40-41 are citable and are not bound
typhoon_h480.sdf sets enable_lockstep true; the fake treats pose and target as silent while paused, which is an assumption of that flag and not a measured PX4 trace

pose and target are explicit reads and are not on the device resource, so a command or a reset does not wait for them; the setpoint receipt reports sent_x, sent_y and sent_z, which are the values handed to rosbridge and not a measurement
the full flight workflow (velocity, acceleration, arm, mode, land and state) is outside this package

the map frame_id on the published PoseStamped follows the iris_0 MAVROS config in this clone; multi_vehicle.launch includes $(find mavros)/launch/px4.launch, which is not in this clone, so that iris file is not shown to be what the typhoon MAVROS launch loads
if enable_ros_network is false, advertiseServices returns without advertising and the e-stop fails closed; the plugin member and empty_world.launch both default it to true
multi_vehicle.launch defaults debug to true, and empty_world.launch then selects node type debug rather than gzserver
the vehicle spawn include is $(find px4)/launch/single_vehicle_spawn_xtd.launch, which is not in this clone

safe_state.description: Gazebo is paused and get_physics_properties read pause true. That flag covers every vehicle in the world. It is not a measured standstill or a disarm. No unpause is offered, because the communication node keeps republishing its retained target and ignores 'stop controlling'; the operator recovers outside MHS.
